global_style: A retro, Morandi-themed presentation using strong color blocking (terracotta and teal), thin white borders, and flat geometric layouts for structured reports.

identity_anchors: Thin white double-line perimeter frame on every slide
Harsh color blocking splitting the canvas into rigid terracotta and teal zones
Flat, borderless geometric shapes (circles, rectangles, hexagons) acting as content containers
Playful, handwritten typography contrasting with rigid geometric grids

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
